current: Four controls, each on the shipped path. (1) Producer credit windows: every `ProduceAck` carries `ProducerCredit { bytes, refills_in_ms }`, the bytes left in the producer's per-second window and when it refills, computed by `Broker::charge_quota` on admission; `Producer::send` holds a batch the credit cannot fund at the producer, naming the refill as `quota_wait`, and never puts it on the wire. (2) Per-producer byte and message quotas, refused with the wait (`charge_quota`). (3) Class-aware admission: P4 shed, P0/P1 told to wait (`OverloadPolicy`). (4) Topic priority on the shared listener: `qip-transport`'s `Server` holds `reserved_for_priority` of `max_concurrent` for callers the handler classes `Priority`; qip-fabricd reserves 16 of 64 (`PRIORITY_RESERVED_CONNECTIONS`) and classes a caller by the catalogue's grants on its authenticated identity (any P0/P1 grant is priority), decided from the request head before the body is read, so a bulk flood is answered 503 past its share before it costs a worker a body. Bounded per-class queues do not exist as queues: a connection past its class's share is refused at once, and the listener backlog is the only queue.
